text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... Did I... win...?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOH!! You're incredible, 
TAISHIIIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (The cheering is... excessively loud.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (...I'm exhausted.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she claimed victory in the Derby, 
the fierce battle against her rivals seems 
to have taken a heavy toll on Narita 
Taishin...

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—Well, there's nothing physically wrong 
with you. It seems you've just grown a bit 
tired.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
"If she rests a little longer, her 
consciousness will... Oh, speak of the 
devil."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Was I asleep?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Exaggerating.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin-san, how are you feeling? 
You're not feeling dizzy anymore, are you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah... Yes. I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Good, good, that's a relief. Don't push 
yourself too hard, and get some rest 
today, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after the doctor left—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAHHH!! DAIZIIIIIIN!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geh.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Taishin, Taishin, Taishin!! 
Col—collapsing?! You can't just 
collap...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin, are you alright? It seems you've 
seen a doctor, but—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I'm completely fine... You 
guys are making way too big a deal out of 
this.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's good. ...Then you'll enter 
the Kikuka Sho as planned, yes?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, that's what I intend to do, 
though?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then there's only one more thing I want to 
say to you right now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —"Next, it's my turn."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...! Hayahide is on fire...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I won't... I won't lose the Kikuka Sho, 
Taishin!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It hurts that the Derby got taken from me, 
but... ...it hurts so, sooo, soooo much, 
but still!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
However, that's why!! I'll turn this 
frustration into fuel, and give it waaaay, 
waaay more of everything I've got!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOH!! Next up is the Kikuka 
Shooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...They just say whatever they want and 
take off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (...But why, I wonder?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(The two of them standing tall—their backs 
looked so dazzling.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I keep tellin' you, you're worrying way 
too much. Come on, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, you'd better train 
properly starting tomorrow, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"If you go easy on me just because you're 
'worried' or whatever, I'll kick your 
butt."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take the Kikuka-sho too... just 
watch me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up next is the final leg of the Triple 
Crown, the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To fend off the two closing in from 
behind, she vowed once again to grow even 
stronger—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
—That's right. All that matters is 
winning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
As long as I keep winning races. I'm sure 
even I can...
